{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import urllib.request

for endpoint in ['/servicios/mariachis/madrid', '/arsenal/luces-navidad']:

            html = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
            h1 = soup.find('h1')
            print(f'=== {endpoint} (HTTP {resp.status}) ===')
            print('H1:', h1.text.strip() if h1 else 'None')
            if 'mariachi' in endpoint:
                h3s = [h.text.strip() for h in soup.find_all('h3')]
                print('Headings:', h3s[:6])
            else:
                imgs = soup.find_all('img')
                print(f'Total img elements: {len(imgs)}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error on {endpoint}:', e)
